_meta.description: Cosmere 5e Invested Arts (plan 2.9) - leveled arts beyond cantrips. Windrunners and Skybreakers have NO leveled Invested Arts per the source: their art lists (Invested Arts book lines 129-138) show only cantrips. They use the Lashing Dice economy for maneuvers instead of Investiture Points for arts. Orders with rich art lists: Edgedancer (79 arts), Truthwatcher (101 arts), Lightweaver (~132 arts), Elsecaller (~96 arts).
_meta.extraction_note: Every entry carries source.book to distinguish between handbook_md (Radiant's Handbook) and invested_arts (The Invested Arts of the Cosmere). The source.line points to the appropriate document. Unreviewed entries MUST NOT adjudicate (plan D5).

invested_arts.name: Adhesion
invested_arts.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Full Lashing Surge. You create one of the following effects:
invested_arts.description_ref: See surgebinding.json surges.Adhesion for full mechanics
invested_arts.notes: Windrunner cantrip. Three-choice utility (stabilize, difficult terrain, stick object with scaling DC).

invested_arts.name: Gravitation
invested_arts.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Basic Lashing Surge. You can use Lashings to do one of the following:
invested_arts.description_ref: See surgebinding.json surges.Gravitation for full mechanics
invested_arts.notes: Windrunner/Skybreaker cantrip. Four effects with level-based scaling: Lash objects (Tiny→Large), Lash creatures (attack roll at 11th), slow fall (reaction).

invested_arts.name: Division
invested_arts.quote: This Invested Art is a minor Division Surge. You can use your action to kindle a fire, lighting a torch, kindling, or something else with abundant, exposed fuel. Instead, you can create one of the following effects using your bonus action:
invested_arts.description_ref: See surgebinding.json surges.Division for full mechanics
invested_arts.notes: Skybreaker cantrip (available at 5th level per Skybreaker art list line 135). Pure utility: kindle fire, decay corpse/plant, burn mark.

invested_arts.name: Abrade
invested_arts.quote: You send Abrasion wildly, slicing through the air, toward a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 axial damage.
invested_arts.desc: You send Abrasion wildly, slicing through the air, toward a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 axial damage. The target gains no benefit from one-quarter, half, or three-quarters cover for this saving throw. This Invested Art's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

invested_arts.name: Abrasive Bolt
invested_arts.quote: You infuse the air with Abrasion and direct it toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged Invested Art attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 axial damage
invested_arts.desc: You infuse the air with Abrasion and direct it toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged Invested Art attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 axial damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage, due to the Surge increasing the friction of the target's body. At Higher Levels: When you cast this Invested Art at 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each level above 1st.

invested_arts.name: Regrowth
invested_arts.quote: A creature you touch recovers a number of hit points equal to 2d8 + your Investiture ability modifier. This Invested Art has no effect on splinters or entities.
invested_arts.desc: A creature you touch recovers a number of hit points equal to 2d8 + your Investiture ability modifier. This Invested Art has no effect on splinters or entities. At Higher Levels: When you cast this Invested Art at 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 2d8 for each level above 1st.

Windrunner.quote:
Windrunner Invested Arts

Cantrips Adhesion Gravitation
Windrunner.notes: Windrunners have zero leveled Invested Arts. They use Lashing Dice for maneuvers (Full Lashing, Reverse Lashing, etc.) instead of Investiture Points for arts.

Skybreaker.quote:
Skybreaker Invested Arts

Cantrips Division (5th level)
Skybreaker.notes: Skybreakers have zero leveled Invested Arts. Division cantrip unlocks at 5th level. They use Lashing Dice for maneuvers instead of Investiture Points for arts.
